THE_SET_IS_CLOSED_AT_TWO: day_tape_pin and day_fragment_pin. Every other assert reachable from build() -- assert_rule20, assert_pool_equality, assert_coverage, assert_index_released, assert_artifacts_absent -- binds to a COMPUTED property, not to a producer's receipt.
WHY_ETH_IS_MISSING_ANY: Neither producer writes its receipt from build(); only main() does, at a path composed from the module's COIN constant. A caller using the library published none -- for ANY coin, which the BTC control run confirms: it too wrote no receipt.

COST_TO_CLOSE.basis: the measured 09-05 ETH fragment wall clock, 3m20s
COST_TO_CLOSE.why: once a coin's receipts exist, later days publish on the first pass through the fixed launcher

PENDING_TEST_peak_ratio_mechanism.mechanism: peak set by the per-day window index (288 for both coins), so memory does not scale with volume
PENDING_TEST_peak_ratio_mechanism.status: INFERRED, UNREPRODUCED -- from a count, not from the allocator; two stages of one day of one coin pair
PENDING_TEST_peak_ratio_mechanism.what_would_settle_it: the next ETH or third-coin build: the peak ratio reproduces or it does not
PENDING_TEST_peak_ratio_mechanism.the_decision_does_NOT_rest_on_it: do-not-overlap rests on the measurement plus 0.7% of soft-limit headroom over single observations
